import React, {FC} from 'react';
import './FilterMenu.scss';

const FilterMenu: FC = () => {
    return (
        <form>
            <label>Filters</label>
            <select name="time" id="sort">
                <option value="" selected disabled hidden>Time period</option>
                <option value="1d">1 day</option>
                <option value="1w">1 day - 1 week</option>
                <option value="1m">1 week - 1 month</option>
                <option value="1mp">1 month+</option>
            </select>
            <select name="priority" id="sort">
                <option value="" selected disabled hidden>Priority</option>
                <option value="1">First priority</option>
                <option value="2">Second priority</option>
                <option value="3">Third priority</option>
                <option value="4">Fourth priority</option>
                <option value="5">Fifth priority</option>
            </select>
            <select name="subject" id="sort">
                <option value="" selected disabled hidden>Subject</option>
                <option value="family">Family</option>
                <option value="health">Health</option>
                <option value="job">Job</option>
                <option value="education">Education</option>
                <option value="hobby">Hobby</option>
                <option value="others">Others</option>
            </select>
        </form>
    );
};

export default FilterMenu;
